summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 16, 2026, reporting the grant of options under its 2020 Plan and restricted share units under its 2019 Plan. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard current report. No special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. It is purely a compensatory grant announcement with no impact on corporate control or capital structure.
